reveal.title: Open the proof of address
reveal.description: The address and document are restricted. Your name, the time and your reason go to the audit log.
reveal.reasonHint: Why you need to see it, for example: "Reviewing the proof sent on Nov 17."

decide.title: Review the proof of address
decide.description: Check that the name matches the account, the address matches what was entered, and the document is dated within 90 days. The helper sees the reason for a rejection, never your note.
decide.reasonRequired: Choose what the helper is told.
decide.noteHint: What you checked and why. At least 10 characters.

actions.request_address: Ask for a new proof of address
actions.request_identity: Ask for a new ID check
actions.allow_double_check_retry: Let them try the double check again

actionHints.request_address: The current verification stops counting, and offers pause until a new proof is approved.
actionHints.confirm_name: Confirm the ID belongs to this person (a nickname or a married name, for example). The ID check then counts.
actionHints.allow_identity_retry: The try count starts again (also after an under-18 result that was a misread).
actionHints.request_identity: The current ID check stops counting, and offers pause until a new one passes.
actionHints.allow_double_check_retry: Our approval stands and the helper can start the double check again (it counts as a try). Use it when the provider's result looks like a glitch.
actionHints.reject_double_check: The approved photos are turned down: the helper is told the double check couldn't verify the ID and can start over within the limits.
actionHints.clear_duplicate_id: After looking at both accounts (the same person's closed account, say): the hold is lifted and the double check can go ahead.
actionHints.reject_duplicate_id: The photos are turned down because the ID is used on another account; the helper is told why. Consider the other account too.
actionHints.engage_background: After reviewing the report at Checkr: in-home categories open for 12 months.
actionHints.pre_adverse_background: Checkr sends the notice with a copy of the report and the summary of rights. The final decision waits 7 days.
actionHints.post_adverse_background: Final: the helper can no longer take in-home categories. Checkr sends the notice.

signals.header_malformed: The barcode's header isn't laid out as AAMVA's standard says.
signals.issuer_unknown: The barcode's issuer number isn't one AAMVA assigned.
signals.issuer_mismatch: The barcode's issuer doesn't match its own subfile or the state on the front.
signals.version_unknown: The barcode's AAMVA version doesn't exist.
signals.version_too_new: The barcode uses an AAMVA version published long after the card's issue date.
signals.subfile_layout_off: The barcode's sections aren't where or as long as its header says.
signals.required_fields_missing: Fields the standard requires are missing from the barcode.
signals.field_format_off: A barcode field is in the wrong format (sex, name flags, ZIP or country).
signals.number_format_off: The license number doesn't have the state's format.
signals.number_derivation_off: The license number doesn't match the name or birth date it's built from.
signals.number_derivation_ok: The license number matches the name, birth date and sex it's built from.
signals.dates_inconsistent: The issue, birth and expiry dates don't fit together.
signals.validity_too_long: The license runs longer than the state allows.
signals.expiry_not_on_birthday: A Florida license that doesn't expire on the holder's birthday.
signals.inventory_mismatch: The 1D barcode's inventory number differs from the PDF417's.
signals.barcode_signature_ok: The state's digital signature on the barcode is valid.
signals.barcode_signature_bad: The state's digital signature on the barcode didn't verify.
signals.mrz_check_digits_ok: Every check digit of the passport's machine-readable zone is right.
signals.front_name_differs: The front's name differs from the barcode's.
signals.front_birth_date_differs: The front's birth date differs from the barcode's.
signals.front_number_differs: The front's number differs from the barcode's.
signals.front_expiry_differs: The front's expiry differs from the barcode's.
signals.id_face_missing: No face found on the ID.
signals.selfie_face_missing: No face found in the selfie.
signals.selfie_many_faces: More than one face in the selfie.
signals.face_mismatch: The selfie's face doesn't match the ID photo.
signals.face_weak_match: The selfie's face only partly matches the ID photo.
signals.selfie_is_id_photo: The selfie is a picture of the ID's own photo.
signals.spoof_suspected: The selfie may be a photo of a photo or a screen.
signals.pose_not_followed: The selfie doesn't show the head turned as asked.
signals.pose_followed: The selfie shows the head turned as asked.
signals.photo_of_screen: The ID photo looks like a photo of a screen.
signals.photocopy: The ID photo is black and white: a copy, not the card.
signals.card_outline_off: The card's outline isn't an ID card's shape.
signals.photo_edited: The photo shows signs of editing.
signals.low_quality: The photos are too dark or blurry.

rejectionReasons.selfie_mismatch: the selfie doesn't match the ID
rejectionReasons.prompt_not_followed: the selfie didn't follow its prompt
rejectionReasons.double_check_failed: the double check didn't confirm the ID
rejectionReasons.duplicate_id: the ID is used on another account

reveal.title: Open the ID photos
reveal.description: The ID photos and selfie are restricted. Your name, the time and your reason go to the audit log.
reveal.reasonHint: Why you need to see them, for example: "Comparing the photos sent on Nov 19."

details.title: Show the ID's details
details.description: What was read from the ID when the photos came in (stored encrypted with them), without opening the photos; for older checks, the barcode on the back read again now. Why you need it is logged with your name and the time.
details.reasonHint: At least 10 characters, for example: comparing the name and address with the account before approving.
details.reasonRequired: Say why in at least 10 characters.
details.logged: Shown and logged: read from the ID's barcode.
details.notStored: Read just now from the barcode and never stored. Compare it with the photos before you decide.
details.name: Name

name.no: doesn't match the account's legal name

address.yes: matches the home address on file
address.no: doesn't match the home address on file
address.none: no home address on file to compare

details.noBarcode: The back has no barcode this server can read (too blurry, or a card without one). Open the photos to check the details.
details.unavailable: The reader couldn't run just now. Try again in a minute, or open the photos.
details.loggedStored: Shown and logged: read from the ID when it was sent.
details.stored: Stored encrypted with the photos and deleted with them. Compare it with the photos before you decide.

decide.title: Review the ID photos
decide.description: Compare the face in the selfie with the photo on the ID, check the selfie follows its prompt, and check the ID is current and readable. Approving opens the provider's double check. The helper sees the reason for a rejection, never your note.
decide.approve: Approve: on to the double check
decide.reasonRequired: Choose what the helper is told.
decide.noteHint: What you compared and why. At least 10 characters.

capture.duplicateCleared: Staff found the same ID in order on {date}.

reading.waiting: Not read automatically yet: the reader gets to it within a few minutes. After {time} you can approve without the reading.
reading.no_reader: No automatic reading here (no reader is set up): approving skips the duplicate-ID check, and the audit log says so.
reading.timed_out: The automatic reading didn’t answer in time: approving skips the duplicate-ID check, and the audit log says so.
